Since 0.1.2. The major version stays 0.

### Play
PlayStation games from RomM play in DuckStation. The BIOS is placed from RomM, and memory cards sync from the folder you pick once in DuckStation (#303). PlayStation 2 games play in ARMSX2. One save-folder pick covers the BIOS and the memory cards, and those cards sync (#305). PlayStation 3 games play in aPS3e, with firmware from RomM and each game's saves synced (#306).

Before a Switch game starts, Eden gets the keys and firmware it is missing from RomM. Eden has to be restarted once before it can see them (#304).

Azahar's 3DS saves sync through RomM (#298).

Leaving a game with Home shows Paused, and A resumes that copy instead of starting a second one. Y › Restart asks first (#290). Resume still holds after Foldcade itself restarts (#293).

### Home
PlayStation, PlayStation 2, and PlayStation 3 are drawn as the consoles, so the three can be told apart. Sega CD has its own mark. Dreamcast no longer reads as the generic pad. A leftover PlayStation 3 folder folds into the one folder. Those folders are named PlayStation 2 and PlayStation 3 (#307).

Moonlight tiles show the box art Moonlight already keeps, and the top screen says whether each computer is up and what it is streaming (#295). Every game on a paired Sunshine or Apollo computer lists itself on Home. You pair once, with a four-digit code (#296).

A download started from Find shows on that game's tile (#299). Each folder can be sorted from its Y menu: Custom, Recent, A-Z, or Most played. The hero shows a game's size on RomM before you download it (#290).

The top screen's backdrop and wide art also slide sideways when the Thor rolls, and they start with less of a turn. Motion Off leaves them still (#294). A lone mark on the top screen no longer sits on a glowing circle (#300).

### Look
A third-party theme can be installed, and a token it relies on keeps its old name working (#292). A pack that crashes Home is put back on the next start (#289).

When calibration takes the bottom button or the menu button, that job moves to a face button that is still free. The hint names the button that does it (#270).

### Fixes
"Saves synced" is not shown when nothing synced. Dates follow the device. About sits on the Settings list, and A there copies one line of debug info. Play activity lists each day's total, and holding X removes one session (#290).

A theme taken out stays out. Done on the RomM token field saves. The options button drops a moving tile after calibration (#293).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
